hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r ".file_path // .path // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$FILE" == *.xslt || "$FILE" == *.xsl ]]; then PORT=$(cat ~/.xslt-debugger-port 2>/dev/null); if [[ -n "$PORT" ]]; then curl -s -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/run-transform" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"stylesheet\": \"$FILE\", \"xml\": \"${FILE%.*}-input.xml\"}"; fi; fi'
